title: Persist Rust SCHC generation-scoped tombstone and admission floors
description: spec/03-adaptation.md §5.6 and draft-lichen-schc-lora-00 require bounded tombstones/floors/hold-down records to persist with authenticated trust/replay state. Rust FragmentationPolicy currently retains receiver tombstones only in RefCell memory; recreating the policy loses terminal high-water and can admit a delayed prior fragment after restart under the same key generation. Add a bounded opaque-generation-bound persistent record/import-export transaction boundary, fail closed on corrupt/colliding/rollback state, and test restart restoration plus retired-generation invalidation.
notes: Implemented signed durable persistence: LICHEN-LINK-TRUST-v1 record serializes local/remote keys, owner-derived durable generation+serial, next serial, replay epoch/window, exact SCHC floor commitment, and anti-rollback revision. Restore creates fresh runtime token after full validation and capacity checks. LICHEN-SCHC-FLOOR-v1 record preserves exact generation/rule/tombstone/outcome/floor, blocks admission if missing, rejects corruption/rollback/revision mismatch, and restores only against committed trust state. Restart/reinstall tests and full gates pass.
